svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

text.tspan: Damage and health are whole numbers.

g.text: Context: Cards, relics and scaling multiply these; fractions drift from the shown total.

text.tspan: The same inputs on the same board always produce the same outcome.

g.text: Context: Replays, the daily seed and every regression test replay a recorded run.

text.tspan: Gold is earned in combat only, never from exploring.

g.text: Context: Encounter rewards are the only pacing lever; a second source breaks that.

text.tspan: A save written by an older build must load in a newer one.

g.text: Context: Players keep runs across updates; fields may be added, never removed or reused.

text.tspan: The game autosaves on room exit, never mid-combat.

g.text: Context: Encounter design treats a fight as atomic; a mid-fight save would undo a bad turn.
